map.鱼药休药期温度校正（度日模型） 使用指南: Fish-Medicine Withdrawal Period Temperature Correction (degree-day model) - User Guide
map.默认参数（标准休药期 14 天 @ 参考温度 15℃、温度下限 5℃、实际水温: Default parameters (standard withdrawal 14 days @ reference temp 15 C, temp lower limit 5 C, actual water temp 22 C): degree-day demand K = 14*(15-5) = 140 C*day; effective temperature = 22-5 = 17...
map.出池上市前按实际水温校正休药期，确保渔药残留低于 MRL，避免药检不合格。: Before harvest/sale, correct the withdrawal period by actual water temperature to ensure fish-drug residues are below the MRL and avoid failed residue tests.
map.水温偏高时药物代谢快，可较标准休药期缩短；水温偏低（尤其接近温度下限）时大幅延长: High water temperature speeds drug metabolism and can shorten the standard withdrawal period; low water temperature (especially near the lower limit) greatly extends it.
map.不同鱼药（恩诺沙星、土霉素、氟苯尼考、磺胺类、甲醛）按各自标准休药期与参考温度校: Different fish medicines (enrofloxacin, oxytetracycline, florfenicol, sulfonamides, formalin) are corrected by their own standard withdrawal periods and reference temperatures.
map.标准 14 天 @15℃ 在水温 22℃ 下的校正: Standard 14 days @ 15 C corrected at water temperature 22 C
map.有效温度 ≤0 时代谢极慢，工具会提示延长休药期并建议送样检测残留，不可直接套用: When effective temperature <= 0, metabolism is extremely slow; the tool prompts to extend the withdrawal period and suggests sampling for residue testing, do not directly apply the formula
map.度日（℃·天）衡量累积温度对药物代谢的驱动，休药期随有效温度成反比，是水产药残控: A degree-day (C*day) measures cumulative temperature driving drug metabolism; the withdrawal period is inversely proportional to effective temperature, a common simplified model for aquaculture residue control.
